fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: Presses down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances, with a 60% chance of [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Kill
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health and deals 24 damage, plus 1.4 times the remaining damage of every affliction on it, which are used up.

fusions.name: Unbothered
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Settled In
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
